articleTitle: Some diffraction characteristics of planar "chiral gratings"
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The diffraction of planar linearly and circularly polarized electromagnetic waves by a plane periodic in two directions in a space grating consisting of metal strip chiral elements has been analyzed. The elements of the grating have an S-shape in particular. A microstrip grating and a grating in free space are considered in the work. The polarization properties of the grating have been studied for resonant conditions.

articleTitle: The antenna pattern synthesis without the side lobes
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The programs applied to the approximate synthesis of continuous pencil-beam antennas without side lobes are derived by the method of partial patterns. The electrical length of the antennas is given. The antenna current distribution is analysed with reference to the dependence of the length of the antenna and to the power of the polynomial, which approximates the pattern.

articleTitle: The scattering of waves by a double-edged wedge with a dielectric cylinder on top
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: Based on re-expanded basis functions in the given interval method a strict solution of the problem has been obtained. The presence of a dielectric shifts the direction of the main maximum in the diagram of scattering and causes a significant effect upon the backscatter cross section of the structure.

articleTitle: The constructive synthesis of a millimeter wave antenna array
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The mathematical model of a millimeter wave antenna array and the aim function with restrictions on the optimization of the direction characteristic is submitted. Results of constructive synthesis for one frequency, and for a range of frequencies are submitted.

articleTitle: On one approach to numerically finding ramification points in antenna synthesis theory according to the prescribed amplitude pattern
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: An approach to numerically finding ramification points of the nonlinear integral operator which arise at antenna synthesis according to the prescribed amplitude pattern is proposed. It consists in substituting the nonlinear integral operator in the polynomial operator beam.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of plane electromagnetic wave resonant reflection from thin strip grating
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: Conditions of the plane electromagnetic wave resonant reflection from a diffraction grating consisting of thinly spaced inclined thin metal strips were verified and studied experimentally. The experimental data obtained are in good agreement with the known theoretical results.

articleTitle: Diffraction of a dipole field by a rectangular screen
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The author uses the uniform geometrical theory of diffraction to derive an asymptotic solution of the three-dimensional diffraction problem of an arbitrarily oriented electric dipole field by an ideally conducting rectangular screen. The amplitude directive patterns are calculated and analysed for the orthogonal field components of the investigated system in different observation planes. The influence of the dipole orientation on the directive patterns of the fields diffracted by the screen and by the edge of the half plane is also examined.

articleTitle: Stochastic analog of the Epstein's transition layer
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: For a random medium having a variance that varies along the same direction as tanh, the mean Green function, as an exact solution of Dyson's equation in a bilocal approximation, is obtained.

articleTitle: Antenna synthesis according to prescribed amplitude radiation pattern and the phase problem
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: Connection between the so-called phase problem in optics and the antenna synthesis problem according to prescribed amplitude pattern is noted. Using the zeros properties of the entire functions of exponential type, the variational antenna synthesis problem solutions are expressed in the analytical form and the problem is reduce to a limited transcendental equation set.

articleTitle: The modified iterative method for calculating completely continuous operator eigenvalues and eigenfunctions
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The modified iterative method (MIM) is discussed. The MIM is a method for obtaining the completely continuous operator eigenvalues and eigenfunctions. The authors correct the formulation and demonstration of the MIM substantive theorem, demonstrate the MIM correlation with a moment method and give some numerical results. The ordinary successive approximation method, which is used to calculate the first eigenvalue and its eigenfunction, consists of multiple iterations by the operator of any initial function for all vanishing next eigenfunctions in its decomposition. When the iterative process becomes stable the final result is obtained from the last two iterations. The MIM allow the use of all iterations with the initial function simultaneously to get the information about all eigenfunctions, not only about the first one. In this case there is a need for far fewer iterations to achieve a prescribed precision. It is also possible to separate each eigenfunction, even those which correspond to eigenvalues with closely placed magnitudes.

articleTitle: Analysis of the scattered field singularities for optimizing the inverse problems solution
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: There are many publications concerning the inverse problems. It is known that such tasks have no unique solution. For example, in the given antenna problem there are different current distributions on the different surfaces. The main problem is to obtain the distribution of these currents that produce the minimum reactive field in the near zone so that the whole feeding energy is transmitted into the travelling wave. Such antenna is called a well matched antenna. On the other hand it is known that the travelling wave is analytical everywhere except in the area of singularities of the radiated field. This paper presents a method for visualisation of this area and the singularities in it. The suggestion is that the simple sources placed in the points of the singularities form a well matched antenna. The problem to be solved is as follows. Given the amplitude and phase distribution in far zone, find the corresponding current distribution and the best location that gives a well matched antenna.

articleTitle: New operations of matrix products for application of radars
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The new concept of face-splitting and transposed face-splitting matrix products is determined; its main characteristics and modifications of the new types of products for module matrices are considered.

articleTitle: Short electromagnetic pulse formation by a plane antenna array
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The spatial-temporal characteristics of short electromagnetic pulses formed by a plane radiator array are investigated. The electromagnetic pulse is shown to essentially depend on the direction, so the notion of a pattern becomes non-simple. The influence of the distance between the radiators and the exciting current pulse length on the pattern formed by the peak amplitude is also studied.

articleTitle: Non-specular reflection of bounded acoustic beam from a porous half-space
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The reflection of a bounded acoustic beam with an even-ordered polynomial cross section from a fluid-porous body plane interface is studied. The porous medium is considered as a two-component mixture of solid and liquid phases with variable porosity parameter. An analysis of the formation process of the reflected beam profile with the incidence angle of the primary wave beam near the critical angles of the surface acoustic waves in the porous material is performed.

articleTitle: Object form reconstruction at small angle base of ultrawideband radar
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: On the basis of generalization of Louis-Boyarsky integral relation including reference fragments for shadow regions of the radar object at a small-angle ultrawideband probing, a method of object form reconstruction from the visible region is suggested. A recursive algorithm for the solution regularization in the presence of measurement noise and a limited frequency band of the pulses used is realized. The efficiency of the method is confirmed by the results of simulation modelling.

articleTitle: The numerical solution of the synthesis deep gaps problem in the directivity pattern of conformal antenna arrays
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: One approach to solving the problem of forming a zero (deep gap) in the directivity pattern in the prescribed direction is considered. It consists in solving the synthesis problem of an arbitrary geometry antenna array by simultaneously forming the zero. The Gram-Shmidt orthogonalization process concerning the partial directivity pattern of elements is used. Application of the suggested algorithm to forming the zero in the directivity pattern of a cylindrical array is presented.

articleTitle: Restoration of radio images of non-coherent radio sources, based on the measured visibility function
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: A new multi-circle method of radio image restoration of radio sources, based on the measured radiointerferometric visibility function, is proposed. The algorithm of the determination of the number of circles, their angular diameter and flux density, based on Fourier-Bessel series, is shown. The radio image of Cas A is restored from measurements of this source. These measurements were performed using the short-baseline (up to 2000 D//spl lambda/) interferometer URAN-3. A model of the large-scale structure, deduced from measurements in the meter wave band, is inconsistent with the results obtained at decameter wavelengths.

articleTitle: Propagation of electromagnetic waves in cylindrical anisotropic dielectric waveguide
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: Summary form only given. Hollow dielectric waveguides are applied as transmission lines in submillimetre and optical ranges, as conducting media in amplifiers and as optical frequency generators. In the submillimetre range hollow dielectric waveguides (in combination with rectangular waveguides) are successfully used as directional couplers. Numerical results are obtained for the constants of symmetrical normal E- and H-type propagation modes for isotropic and anisotropic waveguides. The characteristics of the field intensity distribution of symmetrical H/sub 0n/- and E/sub 0n/-modes in the isotropic dielectric waveguide are also calculated.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a linear antenna array which is placed under an infinite plane screen
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The algorithms for solving problems of amplitude-phase and phase antenna array synthesis according to a given amplitude directivity pattern are presented in this paper. An antenna array under an infinite plane screen is considered. The coupling of the screen and the mutual coupling of the radiators in the array are taken into account. Variational formulations of the problems are reduced to solving the Euler equations, which are nonlinear integral or matrix equations. The number of optimal solutions of the synthesis problem and its qualitative characteristics are investigated by branching theory methods. The numerical results of synthesis are given.

articleTitle: Wiener-Hopf vector equations in the diffraction problems on wedges
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The mixed boundary value problems for the Helmholtz equation with Dirichlet and Neumann boundary conditions on the parts of the opposite faces are solved. Using the Kontorovich-Lebedev integral transformation the problems are reduced to the modified Wiener-Hopf vector equations that allow factorization and conversion to the equivalent infinite systems of linear second kind algebraic equations. These systems can be solved with pre-specified accuracy for any parameter of the problem and these solutions give the required behavior of the sought function at the demarcation line between the boundary conditions. In the static approximation the analytical form of the solutions are obtained.

articleTitle: Solution of 3-D scalar diffraction problem on rectangular strip
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The aim of the paper is to propose a new effective numerical approach to solving the initial problem on the basis of two-dimensional integral equations especially for resonance and short wave ranges. The proposed method for solving the scalar scattering problem allows the construction of an effective algorithm for calculating the scattered field. The initial problem is reduced to a system of linear algebraic equations and are easy to solve.

articleTitle: The Doppler frequency of reflected radio waves from a travelling ionospheric disturbance in the mode of a sinusoidal surface
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: In the geometrical optics approximation, the Doppler frequency of radio waves reflected from a traveling ionospheric disturbance (TID) in the mode of a sinusoidal perfectly reflecting surface is determined.

articleTitle: Investigation of diffraction properties of the single and periodical scatterers made of complex materials
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The problems of electromagnetic scattering and diffraction in complex media, such as absorbing, anisotropic, chiral, biisotropic etc., are the subject of interest of numerous researchers. In spite of the numerous techniques suggested, these problems are still difficult to handle and require appropriate efficient methods of analysis. A uniform approach is developed for solving the wave diffraction problems on the single and periodical objects made of absorbing anisotropic, chiral and biisotropic materials. This approach is based on the method of auxiliary sources and the generalization of Bateman's (1955) procedure for solving Helmholtz' wave equation.

articleTitle: Investigation of aperture penetration of transient fields into a cylindrical cavity
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: Usually metallic shields are used to protect equipment, sensitive electronic parts and systems which can be disturbed or even destroyed by transient EM fields. The propagation of energy into the enclosures occurs principally via transmission lines, transmission line-like structures and different kinds of apertures, realized for cooling purposes and cable connections. This paper presents a numerical study of the coupling of transient fields into a metallic enclosure with apertures. Cylinders with rectangular cross sections are investigated under the illumination of a transient plane wave having the same time-dependence and magnitude, as a Gaussian pulse. The method of investigation is the finite-difference time-domain method.

articleTitle: Exact conditions for virtual boundaries in the FDTD-method in studies of resonance waveguide inhomogeneities
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The exact conditions at the virtual boundaries are formulated and correctly built into computational schemes of the FDTD-method, which is used for analysis of the transient processes in resonance waveguide inhomogeneities. By this means the problem of efficient limitation of the calculation space, which is the main problem of the method, is solved.

articleTitle: Reconstruction and synthesis of reflecting diffraction gratings
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The computational algorithm presented by Wombell and DeSanto (1991), the basic idea of which turns out to be reasonably universal with respect to numerically solvable inverse boundary value problems, can give rise to a large body of simple algorithms that are efficient both in the long wavelength and resonance frequency regions. A number of these potential applications are analyzed. A reflecting grating with an arbitrary profile (a classical object in wave scattering theory) is chosen as a model structure.

articleTitle: Model synthesis of quasi-optical arrangements with gratings-mirrors
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The key problems of model synthesis of quasi-optical arrangements with selective gratings-mirrors are considered. A number of particular examples demonstrate the ways for coordinating the required characteristics of the device as a whole with the possible characteristics of the basic dispersive elements of this arrangement. Optimal means for constructing the packet of input data for grating synthesis are developed. We suggest and implement simple and sufficiently effective approaches to numerical solution of relevant inverse problems.

articleTitle: Propagation of electromagnetic waves in microstrip transmission lines on anisotropic substrates
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: Summary form only given. The characteristics of shielded transmission lines for microwave and millimetre-wave integrated circuits have been investigated in the past. However, in spite of numerous attempts a rigorous theory is not fairly well established. This article presents a rigorous analysis applied to shielded transmission lines on anisotropic substrates. The analysis is based on the method of the Riemann-Hilbert problem in order to obtain determinant equations for the propagation constants and electromagnetic field components. The analytical regularisation procedure reduces the initial boundary value problem to the set of linear algebraic equations of the second kind. The numerical results obtained show that this method allows one to construct efficient numerical algorithms. In the Riemann-Hilbert problem the zero metallization thickness condition is used, therefore the modified Fourier method for calculation of the characteristics of transmission lines with nonzero thickness is suggested. A comparison of the numerical results obtained by both methods is presented.

articleTitle: Influence of an error source's mathematical model on the accuracy of calculation of the directive patterns of a reflector antenna
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The problem of the excitation of an ideal conducting parabolic cylinder reflector by the field of the thread of a synphase magnetic current is considered using Kirchhoff's approximation. The influence of the error source's mathematical model on the results of calculation of the directive patterns of a reflector antenna is investigated.

articleTitle: Synthesis of surface wave antennas in the impedance approximation
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The application of discrete optimization methods in combination with optimal algebraic algorithms to solving systems of linear algebraic equations is proposed for antenna surface impedance synthesis (two-dimensional problem).

articleTitle: Computer-oriented investigation of the synthesis problems of radiating systems according to the prescribed amplitude directivity pattern
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The problems of the radiating systems synthesis according to the prescribed amplitude directivity pattern are considered. These problems are nonlinear since the initial directivity pattern is the amplitude pattern. The numerical methods for their solution are used effectively. The investigations of a series of problems for a number of radiating systems using the unified variational approach are realized. The optimization of the functionals used results form a reduction of the appropriate nonlinear equations or by a direct optimization with the aid of the gradient methods. The programs for solving the synthesis problems of the radiating systems using the proposed algorithms are developed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear interaction of Gaussian sound beams with plane and focusing phase front on the boundary
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: On the basis of a quasioptic approximation method the nonlinear interaction of Gaussian sound beams with different curvature radii of the wave front on the boundary is investigated. A numerically analysis of the amplitude characteristics of the secondary sound field of the difference frequency is also presented.

articleTitle: Wave theory in the non-destructive testing problems
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: Some fundamental problems of mathematical physics which arises in the nondestructive testing of material are formulated. The necessity of modern numerical and numerical-analytical methods application to their solution are shown. The position and role of mathematical modeling in a general non-destructive testing scheme are determined. A survey of the work undertaken at the Karpenko Physico-Mechanical Institute of Ukrainian National Academy of Sciences in the field of non-destructive testing is presented.

articleTitle: Field diffraction of string electric source with running wave of current on plane chiral layer with screen
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The influence of chirality and the phase of a line source on a waveguide and the radiated properties of a planar chiral slab on a perfectly conducting screen are investigated.

articleTitle: Wave diffraction by many element multilayer cylindrical gratings with dielectric layers
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: A rigorous theory of multielement multilayer cylindrical gratings placed inside or outside the dielectric layer is suggested. The diffraction characteristics of the combined gratings with various filings calculated in the far and near zones are presented and discussed. Resonance phenomena of complete reflection and transmission for combined gratings as well as the effects of the enlightenment and darkening of the grating in the presence of dielectric layer are revealed and investigated.

articleTitle: Analysis of the characteristics of the radiation from the open end of an oblique waveguide filled with a limitless dielectric plate
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: In the present work we consider the mechanism of interaction of the edges of two parallel half-planes separated by a dielectric layer unbounded on both sides. The analytical expressions for the characteristics of the radiation into a free space and for the amplitudes of the eigenmodes of the dielectric layer are obtained. A numerical analysis of the relationship between these characteristics and the geometric and material parameters of the structure is carried out.

articleTitle: Hydromagnetic medium eigen waves diffraction on the gratings of metal slabs
publicationTitle: IEEE MTT/ED/AP West Ukraine Chapter DIPED - 97. Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Theory (IEEE Cat. No.97TH8343)
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic waves diffraction on a grating of thick metal slabs, placed in a boundless hydromagnetic medium is solved for three cases of external homogeneous magnetic field orientation: along and across the grating slabs, and normal to the grating.
